{"consolidated_memory":"realtime/ws/session.ts – Three separate dropped-frames incidents (2026-02-24, 2026-06-10, 2026-08-22)

All three incidents involved the same symptom (dropped frames in websocket session, signaled by frames missing from client sequence) in the same file (realtime/ws/session.ts, realtime side), shared the same repro steps (hold socket open through network flap), and are covered by realtime/ws/session.test.ts.

OCCASION 1 – [2026-02-24]
- Trigger: jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR #1186, branch fix/dropped-frames-1
- Measured outcome: p99 latency fell from 6.0 s to 616 ms

OCCASION 2 – [2026-06-10]
- Trigger: sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
- Root cause: two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR #2109, branch fix/dropped-frames-2
- Measured outcome: throughput rose 79 percent to 407 requests per second

OCCASION 3 – [2026-08-22]
- Trigger: users sitting in a negative UTC offset
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware one
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR #6028, branch fix/dropped-frames-3
- Measured outcome: flaky test went from 34 failures per hundred runs to zero

Context: All three fixes target the same corner of realtime/ws/session.ts; context carried over across occasions."}
